$comment: Rad Dog / Neon Surf motion data: bouncy, cartoony, physical. Springs use the same schema as humanist-minimal (stiffness k, damping c, mass m; damping ratio = c / (2 * sqrt(k * m)), below 1 overshoots). Timings are rules of thumb drawn from classic animation principles (squash and stretch, anticipation, overlapping action) and checked by eye at 60 fps; they are not measured from a reference set.
character: Bouncy and cartoony: things land with a squash, overshoot and wobble before they settle, waves roll on a loop, and the mascot gets one small beat (a wink, a shades-glint, a tongue flap). Lively, never frantic: one thing moves at a time and every loop ends on a still frame.

boing.use: Stickers, badges and the headline arriving: about 35% overshoot, one visible bounce.

bouncy.use: Characters and objects popping in: about 25% overshoot.

wobble.use: Jelly wobble after a landing (scale or skew), 3-4 visible oscillations.

snappy.use: UI feedback: buttons pressing into their block shadow and popping back. Little overshoot.

drift.use: Big slow moves: a wave or sun sliding into place.

roll.use: Sine-like loops: waves rolling, palms swaying, a board bobbing.

anticipate.use: A small wind-up before a jump or exit (goes backwards first).

overshoot.use: Fallback for boing/bouncy springs where linear() is not supported.

exit.use: Things leaving: accelerate away, often after an anticipate.

steps.use: VHS jitter and boil: hold-frame jumps, never smooth.

slap.use: A sticker slapped onto the page.

squash.scale: x 1.18, y 0.82 on contact, then the wobble spring back to 1
squash.use: Landing: a character or board hitting the ground or the wave.

stretch.use: Take-off before a jump, after a 100 ms anticipate.

wiggle.use: A character or sticker saying 'look at me' once; or a CTA after 4 s idle.

rollWave.use: The wave face shifting and foam scallops rising and falling, looping.

bob.use: A rider bobbing on the board, looping.

drawOn.use: Outlines drawing on before the fills pop (optional intro).

splat.use: Splatter core scales from 0 with the boing spring, droplets follow 40 ms apart.

sprayIn.use: Spray stipple dots appear in a random but seeded order.

glint.use: A white glint sliding across the shades or a sticker.

boil.use: Hand-drawn line boil: alternate 2-3 slightly different outlines at 8 fps. Accent only, e.g. a title card.

vhsJitter.use: Horizontal jitter and colour-channel split on one element, once, for a retro beat. Never on body text; never repeated more than once per 5 s.

durations.$comment: Snappier than humanist-minimal: cartoons read fast. Rule of thumb.
durations.formula: duration = 180 ms + 0.3 ms per pixel travelled (capped at 700 ms)

order: pattern band (slides in on its diagonal)
choreography.settleBeforeText: Text slaps on when the hero has landed (after its squash), so the joke reads first.

loop.endsOn: A still frame that works as a poster on its own: hero settled, wave at rest.

rules: Springs with overshoot for arriving, sine loops for water, anticipation and acceleration for leaving.
Squash and stretch keep the area roughly constant (x * y between 0.95 and 1.05).
One thing loops at a time: usually the wave or the rider's bob.
VHS jitter and line boil are seasoning: one short burst, never continuous, never on text people need to read.
No flashing faster than 3 times per second (WCAG 2.3.1) and no full-screen colour strobes.
Text may slap and wiggle once on arrival; it never loops.
With reduced motion: show the final frame; loops, wiggles, boil and jitter stop.
